limits: This is a read-only path-and-content equivalence check. It does not rerun coverage, performance, compilation, or instrumentation.
It does not restate the 2a4e source-tree coverage or performance runs as whole-workspace or whole-source 1a278 runs.

The performance result remains specific to its recorded hardware, build profile, private target state, source-variant controls, and timing conditions. Matching measured inputs does not prove identical code generation or incremental-cache state.
The coverage result remains three separate focused cohorts. Their branch observations are not aggregated into workspace or product coverage.
